question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (2). i.e. "**Braed**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Braed" is Incorrectly spelt in the given sentence.
 
• The Correct spelling is Bread (ब्रेड) A food made of flour, water, and yeast mixed and baked.
 
 
• **Example**: She baked bread.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Braed**".
